name: Tsuki Ugatsu Kyousou
source:
Mysterious disappearances start to happen around the town's central skyscraper. According to rumors, before the incident girl in black appears at the spot. On the third moonlight blackness fills everything in these jungle from glass and stone.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
小镇中心的摩天大楼周围，开始接连发生神秘失踪事件。传闻每次事发前，现场都会出现一名黑衣少女。第三次月光降临时，黑暗将笼罩这片玻璃与石头构成的丛林。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
